7352.title: Nested model menu leaks keyboard navigation
7352.rootCauseOneLine: The nested model submenu leaves ArrowRight unconsumed, allowing the enclosing picker's reasoning shortcut to advance the reasoning value.
7352.proposedFix: Consume horizontal navigation in the submenu while preserving ArrowRight focus and Escape/ArrowLeft dismissal; retain the outer picker's reasoning shortcuts.
7352.caveats: Same-agent reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts using the actual React components and portal in jsdom; no full browser session. Reproduction code and expected/actual output are inline because this public report repository forbids committed test artifacts.
